how: dpkg -i --force-depends (the test image has no dpkg python3 package); HA_SMALL_WHEELHOUSE=/wheelhouse /usr/bin/ha-small-setup for the offline install
boundary: Built and tested on Debian 13 x86_64 containers. No distro today ships python3.14 as a dpkg package, so Depends cannot be satisfied by apt; the wheelhouse is x86_64 only, so there is no aarch64 deb yet. No systemd boot test (containers have no systemd PID 1).
